name: app-monospace-crypto-wallet-and-swap-screens-with-black-pill-buttons
title: Monospace Crypto Wallet and Swap Screens
whatItIs: Two white phones set entirely in monospace type: a wallet home with a big balance in pixel-like numerals, currency pills, black Request and pale Withdraw buttons and an asset list with coin icons, and a swap screen with sell and buy fields, percentage chips, a numeric keypad and a black Swap pill.
whatItMeans: Monospace type gives a code-like, technical honesty to money, and black pills stay decisive against white.
techniques: Monospace throughout for a terminal feel
Large monospace balance as the hero
Black pill for the primary action
Soft rounded keys on a light grey keypad

vocabulary.definition: An interface where every character has equal width.
Quick buttons for choosing 25%, 50% or max of a balance.
A round button reversing the sell and buy assets.
